name: harmonic number
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 谐波频率相对于基频的整数倍数。
usage_overview: 用于标识谐波频率相对于基频的整数倍关系。在列车作用下的桥梁动力分析中，可据此辨别高次谐波，识别造成响应放大的激励来源。

complete_examples.text: The proposed model can be thoroughly utilised to calculate the harmonic number, which may cause amplification in the bridge response.
It has been further observed that a nonlinear relationship exists between harmonic number, train speed and fundamental time period of a bridge.

P093.title: Influence of dominant frequencies and their higher harmonics on the dynamic responses of railway bridge subjected to high-speed trains
P093.authors: NK Kedia, C Ngamkhanong, Y Singh, L Xu
P093.label: Kedia等（2025）

contexts.text: 表示频率为基频多少倍的整数，用于识别响应放大的激励来源。
contexts.title: 主导频率及其高次谐波对高速列车作用下铁路桥梁动力响应的影响
